assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md explicitly notes imprecise data: 'Affected version range | "versions prior to the fix" (imprecise -- no concrete threshold in Jira description)' and 'Fixed version | "see advisory" (imprecise -- no concrete version in Jira description)'. The Critical Data Gap section further states: 'The Jira description provides imprecise version range information: Affected versions: "versions prior to the fix" -- no specific version threshold'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md documents the MITRE CVE API query (source: https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901) and extracts 'Affected range | lessThan 0.4.8' with 'Version type | semver'. The narrative confirms: 'The MITRE CVE record provides a precise affected version range: all semver versions less than 0.4.8 are affected.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md documents the OSV.dev API query (source: https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901) and extracts 'Introduced | 0 (all versions from initial release)' and 'Fixed | 0.4.8'. The narrative confirms: 'The OSV.dev record confirms the fix version is 0.4.8, with all prior versions affected from the initial release.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md contains a cross-validation table comparing Jira (imprecise), MITRE (< 0.4.8), and OSV.dev (fixed 0.4.8), with explicit result: 'Result: Agreement. MITRE and OSV.dev both report the fix threshold as 0.4.8.' The section concludes: 'Fix threshold: < 0.4.8 -- any h2 version below 0.4.8 is vulnerable. This enriched fix threshold is used in Step 2.3 for version impact comparisons.'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md opens with: 'From Step 1.5 cross-validation: h2 < 0.4.8 is vulnerable. Versions >= 0.4.8 are not affected (0.4.8 is the fix version per both MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev).' All version comparisons use 0.4.8 as the threshold (e.g., '0.4.5 < 0.4.8' for affected, '0.4.8 >= 0.4.8' for not affected). The Jira's imprecise data is not used for any comparison.
